q: Thou art but a warner.

s: Muhammad is a bearer of glad tidings (sent with the Truth)
q: Lo! We have sent thee with the Truth, a bearer of glad tidings and a warner

s: messengers of Allah are denied mankind (by disbelievers)
q: And if they deny thee, (O Muhammad), messengers (of Allah) were denied before thee.

s: messengers of Allah are sent to mankind (as warners)
q: and there is not a nation but a warner hath passed among them.

s: the angels are messengers Allah (having two, three and four wings)
q: Who appointeth the angels messengers having wings two, three and four.

s: mankind is in need of Allah (as the poor in relation to Him)
q: O mankind! Ye are the poor in your relation to Allah.

s: Allah is able to do all things
q: He multiplieth in creation what He will. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.

s: mankind is subject to judgment and accountability (for what they deserve)
q: If Allah took mankind to task by that which they deserve

s: mankind is created from dust (then from a little fluid)
q: Allah created you from dust, then from a little fluid

s: believers receive forgiveness (with good works)
q: those who believe and do good works, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward.

s: believers receive reward (great)
q: those who believe and do good works, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward.

s: disbelievers receive an awful doom
q: Those who disbelieve, theirs will be an awful doom

s: disbelievers are subject to hell (their torment is not lightened)
q: But as for those who disbelieve, for them is fire of hell; it taketh not complete effect upon them so that they can die, nor is its torment lightened for them.

s: disbelief causes loss (for disbelievers)
q: Their disbelief increaseth for the disbelievers naught save loss.

s: the devil is an enemy of mankind (so he should be treated as an enemy)
q: Lo! the devil is an enemy for you, so treat him as an enemy.

s: the devil summons the devil's faction (to become owners of the flaming Fire)
q: He only summoneth his faction to be owners of the flaming Fire.

s: the devil's faction is destined for hell (the flaming Fire)
q: He only summoneth his faction to be owners of the flaming Fire.

s: Allah is mighty the Mighty
q: He is the Mighty, the Wise.

s: the erudite fear Allah (alone)
q: The erudite among His bondmen fear Allah alone.

s: the heavens are created by Allah
q: Praise be to Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth

s: the earth is created by Allah
q: Praise be to Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth

s: the heavens are grasped by Allah (so that they do not deviate)
q: Lo! Allah graspeth the heavens and the earth that they deviate not

s: the earth is grasped by Allah (so that it does not deviate)
q: Lo! Allah graspeth the heavens and the earth that they deviate not

s: hell is a fire (whose torment does not end in death)
q: for them is fire of hell; it taketh not complete effect upon them so that they can die

s: Allah is wise the Wise
q: He is the Mighty, the Wise.

s: Gardens of Eden contain gold (as armlets worn by inhabitants)
q: They enter them wearing armlets of gold and pearl and their raiment therein is silk.

s: Gardens of Eden contain silk (as raiment worn by inhabitants)
q: They enter them wearing armlets of gold and pearl and their raiment therein is silk.

s: the Scripture is the Truth (confirming what was revealed before it)
q: As for that which We inspire in thee of the Scripture, it is the Truth confirming that which was (revealed) before it.

s: the Scripture is given as inheritance to Allah's slaves (those elected by Allah)
q: Then We gave the Scripture as inheritance unto those whom We elected of Our bondmen.

s: the Resurrection is like revival of the earth (after its death)
q: And Allah it is Who sendeth the winds and they raise a cloud; then We lead it unto a dead land and revive therewith the earth after its death. Such is the Resurrection.

s: the promise of Allah is true
q: O mankind! Lo! the promise of Allah is true.

s: creation is multipled by Allah (as He wills)
q: He multiplieth in creation what He will.

s: judgment and accountability is based on what mankind deserve (under Allah's judgment)
q: If Allah took mankind to task by that which they deserve

s: Allah controls mercy (by opening or withholding it)
q: That which Allah openeth unto mankind of mercy none can withhold it; and that which He withholdeth none can release thereafter.
